quotes.text:
It got, about a month ago: https://apps.apple.com/se/app/superalarm-alarm-clock-sleep/id6480463426?l=en-GB

v2.5.1

Hey HN! I made a new app called SuperAlarm. If you’re a heavy sleeper who struggles to wake up, this feature-packed alarm app is designed just for you.

[Top features]

1. “Missions” you must complete to turn off the alarm, ensuring you get out of bed. We’re starting with math missions but let us know what other challenges you’d like to see!

2. Custom alarm tones selected by our team to jolt you awake. Tell us your favorite alarm sounds and we’ll add them.

3. Set a daily memo that displays after you turn off the alarm. Start your morning with a motivating message or reminder to kickstart your day right!

4. When you snooze, SuperAlarm goes into iPhone’s dynamic island to display time left until next ring.

5. Clean, intuitive interface combined with powerful functionality. Most feature-rich alarm apps are expensive, but SuperAlarm is totally free, supported by unobtrusive ads. We’ll be adding an affordable one-time purchase option to go ad-free.

We built SuperAlarm because we were frustrated with oversleeping and found existing alarm apps lacking in features, design, or price. Our goal was to create the ultimate alarm clock experience to help you start your day right.

SuperAlarm is available now on the App Store(Android version coming in May).
Please check it out and share your feedback - we’d love to hear your thoughts, suggestions and feature requests. We’re committed to making this the most powerful, customizable and user-friendly alarm clock app available.
